mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.partner_code, pt.name AS partner_name, p.plan_type, p.partner_plan_code, p.status, p.activation_url, p.published_version_id, d.id AS draft_version_id, COALESCE(d.name, pv.name) AS name, CASE WHEN d.id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(d.monthly_price, d.charge_price) ELSE COALESCE(pv.monthly_price, pv.charge_price) END AS price, COALESCE(d.network, pv.network) AS network, pv.published_at, d.publish_at, p.last_collected_on, p.ended_on FROM plan p JOIN partner pt ON pt.code = p.partner_code LEFT JOIN plan_version pv ON pv.id = p.published_version_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT * FROM plan_version x WHERE x.plan_id = p.id AND x.published_at IS NULL AND x.discarded_at IS NULL ORDER BY x.version_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) d ON TRUE
mapper.select: ORDER BY pt.sort_order, p.status = 'ENDED', name, p.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
WHERE p.id IN #{id} ORDER BY p.id
SELECT id FROM plan WHERE partner_code = #{partnerCode} AND plan_type = #{planType} AND partner_plan_code = #{code}
SELECT id FROM plan WHERE partner_code = #{partnerCode} AND partner_plan_code = #{code} AND status <> 'ENDED' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
INSERT INTO plan (partner_code, plan_type, partner_plan_code, status, activation_url) VALUES (#{partnerCode}, #{planType}, #{code}, 'PENDING', #{activationUrl}) RETURNING id
mapper.sql: id, plan_id, version_no, name, data_text, data_gb, qos_text, voice_text, sms_text, network, generation, monthly_price, charge_price, valid_days, discount_months, price_after_discount, array_to_string(tags, '|') AS tags, array_to_string(supplemented_fields, '|') AS supplemented_fields, array_to_string(changed_fields, '|') AS changed_fields, collected_on, publish_at, published_at, published_by, reviewer, approver, approved_at, discarded_at, crawl_item_id, source_hash
mapper.select: SELECT FROM plan_version WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND discarded_at IS NULL ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM plan_version WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND published_at IS NULL AND discarded_at IS NULL ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM plan_version WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY version_no DESC
SELECT COALESCE(max(version_no), 0) + 1 FROM plan_version WHERE plan_id = #{planId}

INSERT INTO plan_version (plan_id, version_no, name, data_text, data_gb, qos_text, voice_text, sms_text, network, generation, monthly_price, charge_price, valid_days, discount_months, price_after_discount, tags, supplemented_fields, changed_fields, collected_on, reviewer, approver, approved_at, crawl_item_id, source_hash) VALUES (#{planId}, #{versionNo}, #{name}, #{dataText}, #{dataGb}, #{qosText}, #{voiceText}, #{smsText}, #{network}, #{generation}, #{monthlyPrice}, #{chargePrice}, #{validDays}, #{discountMonths}, #{priceAfterDiscount}, #{tags,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}, #{supplementedFields,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}, #{changedFields,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}, #{collectedOn}, #{reviewer}, #{approver}, now(), #{crawlItemId}, #{sourceHash}) RETURNING id
SELECT count(*) FROM plan_version WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND published_at IS NULL AND discarded_at IS NULL AND publish_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE plan_version SET discarded_at = now() WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND published_at IS NULL AND discarded_at IS NULL

UPDATE plan_version SET name = #{v.name}, data_text = #{v.dataText}, data_gb = #{v.dataGb}, qos_text = #{v.qosText}, voice_text = #{v.voiceText}, sms_text = #{v.smsText}, network = #{v.network}, generation = #{v.generation}, monthly_price = #{monthlyPrice}, charge_price = #{chargePrice}, valid_days = #{validDays}, discount_months = #{v.discountMonths}, price_after_discount = #{v.priceAfterDiscount}, tags = #{tags,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}, supplemented_fields = #{supplemented,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler} WHERE id = #{id} AND published_at IS NULL AND discarded_at IS NULL
UPDATE plan SET status = #{status}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{planId}
UPDATE plan SET activation_url = #{url} WHERE id = #{planId} AND (activation_url IS NULL OR activation_url = '')
UPDATE plan SET activation_url = #{url}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{planId}
UPDATE plan_version SET publish_at = #{publishAt} WHERE id = #{versionId} AND published_at IS NULL AND discarded_at IS NULL
UPDATE plan_version SET publish_at = NULL WHERE id = #{versionId} AND published_at IS NULL
UPDATE plan_version SET published_at = now(), published_by = #{by}, publish_at = COALESCE(publish_at, now()) WHERE id = #{versionId} AND published_at IS NULL AND discarded_at IS NULL
UPDATE plan SET published_version_id = #{versionId}, status = CASE WHEN status = 'HIDDEN' THEN 'HIDDEN' ELSE 'PUBLISHED' END, ended_on = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{planId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM plan_version WHERE publish_at <= now() AND published_at IS NULL AND discarded_at IS NULL ORDER BY publish_at, id
mapper.update: UPDATE plan_version SET discarded_at = now() WHERE id = #{versionId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM plan_version WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND published_at IS NOT NULL AND discarded_at IS NULL AND id <> #{beforeVersionId} AND version_no < (SELECT version_no FROM plan_version WHERE id = #{beforeVersionId}) ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*) FROM plan_version WHERE publish_at >= #{from} AND publish_at < #{to} AND published_at IS NULL AND discarded_at IS NULL
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM monthly_pick WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND exposed)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monthly_pick (partner_code, plan_id, site_order, partner_plan_code, crawl_item_id, collected_on) VALUES (#{partnerCode}, #{planId}, #{siteOrder}, #{code}, #{itemId}, #{collectedOn})
mapper.update: UPDATE plan SET status = 'HIDDEN', updated_at = now() WHERE partner_code = #{partnerCode} AND plan_type = #{planType} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
